fantastic-imagination.effectTop: Reveal 1 Landscape. If Lucidity 0-2, Reveal +1. If Lucidity 3+, Return 3 Cards.

centering.effectTop: Draw 2 Psyche. All Dreamers Draw 1 Psyche & 1 Power Token. Then Move to an adjacent Landscape.

the-ascent.effectTop: Discard your highest Psyche, then Draw 2 Psyche.
the-ascent.effectBottom: Dreamers on Affected Landscapes may also use this effect.

beyond-comprehension.effectTop: Flip Leviathan. Instead, Forget 4 Landscapes. Return 4 cards.

just-a-dream.effectBottom: Return 1 Card for each Affected Landscape.

morning-routine.effectTop: Draw 1 Psyche. Repress top 1 Lucidity Mindstream card.
morning-routine.effectBottom: Draw Psyche up to the number of Affected Landscapes.

transported.effectTop: Draw 2 Psyche. 1st is column, 2nd is row of Dreamscape. Move to this Landscape.

harmonic-resonance.effectTop: If Lucidity 1, Draw 1 Psyche. If Lucidity 3+, Return 2 Cards. Draw +1 Psyche or Return +2.

forgot-clothes.effectTop: Repress 1 Psyche from hand. If Lucidity 1-2, Move adjacent. If Lucidity 3+, Move anywhere.

pop-quiz.effectTop: Draw 1 Psyche. Guess if next Psyche is Higher or Lower. Correct: Return Personae+3.

sacred-geometry.effectTop: Move to any Landscape adjacent to Bed.

a-shining-wind.effectBottom: Move to Silver Mist or Endless Ocean.

roof-dive.effectBottom: Move to Sky, The Party, or Candy Mountain.

into-the-next.effectTop: All Dreamers Draw 1 Psyche. Move to adjacent Landscape & take a free Action.

running-somewhere.effectBottom: Elasticity 3+, may Discard 1 Psyche to Return cards equal to its value.

portal-another-world.effectTop: Elasticity 0-2 Move 1. Elasticity 3+ Move 3. Move to edge of Dreamscape.

undulating-floor.effectTop: Move to Any Landscape. Place 1 Power Token on an available Archetype.

get-up.effectBottom: May Move to Forest if Revealed. Move to Attic and take free Meet.

get-down.effectBottom: May Move to City if Revealed. Move to Basement and take free Meet.

revolving.effectTop: Draw 3 Psyche. Repress 1 Psyche from hand. Swap Positions with any other Dreamer.

blooming.effectTop: Swap Positions of any 4 unoccupied Landscape Hexes. Repress 1 Psyche from hand.

break-out.effectTop: Discard 1 Psyche. Draw 1 Psyche. If it matches hand, Return 4 Cards.

a-thousand-daggers.effectTop: All Dreamers collectively Discard Dreamers+2 Psyche.

heating-up.effectTop: Spawn 1 Encounter, Meet it. If Accept spawn another; if Repress Draw Psyche up to hand limit.

no-thing.effectTop: Discard 3 Dream Cards. Willpower 3+, Return 1 Dream card to deck and shuffle.

no-where.effectTop: Forget 4 Landscapes. Repress top 1 Psyche from Psyche deck. Draw 2 Psyche for grid move without Meet.

choppy-water.effectTop: Discard 1 Willpower Psyche to Draw 1 Psyche and Return 4 Cards.

clear-as-crystal.effectTop: Willpower 2 or less: Draw 3 Psyche. Willpower 3+: Draw 3 Psyche and Return 2.

jaw-shark.effectTop: Discard 2 Willpower Psyche or else Repress 2 Psyche from hand. If unable, Discard all Objects.

golden-tooth.effectTop: Willpower 1-2: Draw 2 Psyche. Willpower 3+: Draw 1 Object from any Mindstream.

who-is-there.effectTop: Spawn an Encounter and Meet Now. Instead, Draw 2 Encounters, Pick 1. Repress top 1 Willpower Mindstream card.

no-one.effectTop: Discard all active Encounters. Willpower 3+, Instead Discard 1 Encounter.

contagion.effectBottom: Lucidity 2 or less, Repress +1 Psyche per Affected Landscape.
